title: Implement audit-root attestation payloads
summary: Add a concrete audit-root-attestation.v1 generator and verifier so local audit integrity reports can be bound to commits and tasks before release signing is wired.
expectedFailureModes: Audit-root signing remains only an ADR with no payload schema or verifier.
Generated root payloads contain local paths, personal identifiers, or unsigned claims that read like public non-repudiation.
The verifier accepts malformed roots, invalid audit reports, non-canonical commits, or stale task snapshots.
humanEscalation: Selecting the public signing identity remains a human governance decision.
nextAction: Integrated locally; next hardening should choose the project signing identity and add signature generation/verification.
